consistency_audit.candidate_name_collision: The older H2 spatial-scope candidate is a separate out-of-bounds resource interaction and must not be merged with this dash-through-wall environment.
consistency_audit.known_historical_priority_conflict: docs/bug_specifications_ko.md section 6; intentionally not consolidated without approval

evaluation_contract_for_learning.adaptation_zero_check: Evaluate the fixed-pretrained policy immediately on mutant before any adaptation to measure accidental wall passing.
evaluation_contract_for_learning.interpretation_guard: The wall-pass oracle is diagnostic. Success and same-policy kernel return differences, not the designer-defined exploit label alone, establish task payoff.
primary: same frozen adapted policy evaluated under mutant and fixed kernels

interface.observation_schema_hash_basis: sha256 of compact sorted JSON containing map_shape, map_channels, and model_features
public_global_navigation_features: signed camp relative row and column
signed item relative row and column

leakage_audit.independence_boundary: This stage supplies internal consistency evidence for a synthetic contract, not external ground truth.
mitigations: derive trigger independently from before/after coordinates and frozen barrier cells rather than trusting the kernel event flag
make same-policy fixed/mutant success and return the primary payoff comparison
report transformed test layouts as held-out geometry only, never as independent defect-family generalization
obtain an independent implementation review before opening a publication claim; no such review is claimed here
leakage_audit.shared_pool_bias: fires for layout splits: all 48 layouts are transforms of one canonical fixture
leakage_audit.tautology_risk: fires for the exploit label: the designer defines and scores trigger-followed pickup and delivery
leakage_audit.verifier_equals_designer: fires: kernel, fixture, and oracle were authored in the same repository and author scope

learning_gate_remaining: run the frozen four-cell fixed natural-start normal-task gate
adjudicate each method against the preregistered two-seed mode-and-sample threshold
open mutant adaptation only for methods whose two development seeds pass

mutation.beneficial_use: after a trigger, acquire the target item and deliver it to camp
mutation.fixed: destination must be valid and the intermediate barrier cell must be clear
mutation.mutant: destination must be valid; the intermediate barrier predicate is omitted
mutation.site: two-cell dash intermediate barrier collision predicate
mutation.trigger: a successful two-cell dash whose intermediate coordinate is a barrier cell
unchanged: intermediate out-of-map and non-wall void rejection
item pickup, delivery, time, observation, goals, and reward

priority_change.anti_tuning_rule: Freeze the fixture before PPO or Dual outcomes are viewed; do not change geometry, reward, or horizon to make either method win.
priority_change.current_decision: The latest research direction explicitly selects a small spatial wall-pass task to test defect-family generality. The historical note remains unedited; this manifest records the branch-local decision.
priority_change.historical_note: docs/bug_specifications_ko.md previously deprioritized unconditional wall passing because accidental activation could weaken learning discrimination.

research_question: Outside resource duplication, do validated PPO and Dual policies adopt a beneficial spatial-rule violation during adaptation, and does the same frozen policy lose success or return when the violation is removed?
scope_exclusions: large maps, mining, crafting, combat, or survival
environment tuning based on PPO or Dual outcomes
mutant adaptation before the fixed normal-learning gate passes

storage_record.decision: RAID only; /home/ext_csv reports 90% used in df.

task.fixed_counterfactual: replay the exact eight exploit actions with the intermediate collision restored; delivery must fail
task.normal_rule: retrieve the item and return it to camp while the intermediate-cell collision rule is enforced
task.sparse_reward: 1 on the transition that first delivers the carried item, otherwise 0

understood_as: Implement and validate a small synthetic item-return kernel whose only fixed/mutant difference is the intermediate-cell collision check for a two-cell dash; verify a shared normal path, a mutant wall-pass path, the same actions under fixed, and unrelated negative controls before wiring or launching PPO or Dual training.

validation.exact_shortest_path_search: BFS over 87 reachable canonical physical states per kernel
validation.kernel_stage: transition, observation, reward wrapper, internal oracle, and constructive path validation
validation.learner_cpu_smoke: GC-PPO and Dual one update plus frozen fixed/mutant evaluation completed

world.canonical_floor: rows 6..12 and columns 6..12 except non-wall void [12,12]
world.layouts: 16 per train/validation/test split: D4 transform plus one of two split-specific translations
world.non_wall_void_purpose: break fixture reflection symmetry so all D4 layout indices are distinct; both kernels reject it and it is not part of the mutation
world.split_limit: All splits are transforms of one authored fixture; test is not evidence of new-mechanism or new-map-family generalization.
